LESSON: MOVEMENT OF MATERIALS IN AND OUT OF THE CELL

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 2.2: Movement of materials in and out of the cell
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 16

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Movement of materials in and out of the cell, part of Living Things and their Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 INTEGRATED SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How do materials move in and out of a cell?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Movement of materials in and out of the cell together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: The learner acquires writing skills as while recording findings from experiments to

demonstrate diffusion and osmosis.

● Self-efficacy: The learner executes assigned tasks successfully while carrying out experiments to demonstrate diffusion and

osmosis.

Values:
● Respect: The learner appreciates the opinions of peers when discussing the roles of diffusion and osmosis in living

things.

● Responsibility: The learner plays assigned roles while carrying out experiments to demonstrate semi-permeability of

the cell membrane.

16

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Environmental education and climate change: The learner learns how to disposes of waste materials from experiments

to demonstrate diffusion and osmosis appropriately.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: How do materials move in and out of a cell?
